# Security & Privacy Requirements Checklist: Identity, Access & App Shell

**Purpose**: Test whether R1's security and privacy requirements are complete, clear, consistent and
measurable before tasks are generated (authentication, invite-only access, isolation, owner-admin
powers incl. erasure, sessions, lockout, app lock, audit, secrets/environments).
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are requirements defined for how the owner-admin regains access if they lose their sign-in method (forgotten password is covered, but lost Google account or compromised mailbox is not)? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK002 - Does the spec state that possession of the invitation link is what proves control of the invited email for the email + password path (i.e., no separate email verification step)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK003 - Are invitation-token properties specified as requirements — single use, unguessable, never shown to the owner-admin, not written to logs or audit details? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, Plan R-02]
- [x] CHK004 - Are abuse limits specified for public, unauthenticated actions — invitation lookups and password-reset requests — to prevent enumeration and email flooding? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK005 - Are transport-security requirements stated (all traffic encrypted in transit; no plain-HTTP access to any environment)? [Gap, Constitution D2]
- [x] CHK006 - Are web session-cookie protections specified (not readable by page scripts, sent only over encrypted connections, protected against cross-site request forgery for state-changing admin actions)? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the expected behaviour defined when a biometric enrolment on the device changes (e.g., a new fingerprint is added) while app lock with biometrics is on? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK008 - Is it specified whether app lock requires the device itself to have a secure screen lock, and what happens on devices without one? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK009 - Is retention defined for audit events and for disabled users' data (how long kept, whether ever purged)? [Gap, Spec §FR-037, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 - Are requirements defined for rotating the privileged backend key and the SMTP credential if either leaks, including invalidating existing sessions where needed? [Gap, Constitution VI]
- [x] CHK011 - Is there a requirement that a demo build can never be configured against the live backend (and vice versa), or a detectable guard against that misconfiguration? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK012 - Are privacy-notice requirements defined for invited testers (what is stored about them, who can see their email/last sign-in, how to request erasure)? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK013 - Is it specified whether the owner-admin is notified of security-relevant events (repeated lockouts, failed sign-ins on their own account), or is this intentionally excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK014 - Is the password-reset link lifetime quantified ("time-limited" has no value) and is it single-use? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK015 - Are the lockout counting rules unambiguous — which window the 5 failures must fall in, whether a success resets the count, whether the lockout applies per email regardless of device/IP, and whether Google sign-in is affected? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK016 - Is "commonly used passwords" defined with a measurable source or size (e.g., a named list of N entries)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK017 - Does FR-010 state precisely which sessions end on password reset — all of the user's sessions on all devices, including the one completing the reset? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK018 - Is "within 1 minute" for disable/revoke defined against a reference event (from the owner's confirmation to the affected device's next request), and how is an idle device handled? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK019 - Is "masks every monetary amount" bounded — does it include amounts in screen titles, toasts, charts, exported images, and Android notifications in later modules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the scope of screenshot/recents protection clear — only while app lock is enabled, or always? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK021 - Does FR-039 specify whether a user's own sign-in activity includes failed attempts and lockouts (needed to notice an attack on their account)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK022 - Is erasure consistent across all stored copies of the email: the data model keeps `invitations.email` after the user is erased, while FR-016a and constitution III require identifiers to be removed? [Conflict, Spec §FR-016a, Data Model §Invitation]
- [x] CHK023 - Do the disable requirements agree on timing — US4 scenario 4 says "at their next interaction", FR-015 says "end all sessions", SC-007 says "within 1 minute"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK024 - Is the edge case "disabled user keeps local, view-only access while offline" consistent with FR-015 ("prevent sign-in") and constitution Principle I, and is that offline window bounded? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 - Does FR-016 ("owner-admin MUST NOT view … preferences") align with FR-014, which shows display name — is display name classified as a profile field rather than a preference throughout? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK026 - Are the residual risks accepted in the plan (lockout bypass via direct Auth API; self-set weak password) reflected in the spec's Assumptions so the spec and plan agree on what FR-007/FR-009 guarantee? [Consistency, Plan R-04/R-05]
- [x] CHK027 - Are the audit action names in FR-037 and the data model's action list the same set (data model adds `sign_in_locked`, `setup_completed`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-037, Data Model §Audit Event]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK028 - Is SC-003 ("0 cases" of cross-user access) tied to a defined set of access rules, so that "0 cases" is measured against an agreed list rather than whatever tests happen to exist? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Contracts database.md]
- [x] CHK029 - Can SC-006 ("0 unmasked amounts") be measured objectively — is the set of screens and amount locations to review defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK030 - Is there an acceptance criterion proving that erasure leaves no retrievable personal data (database rows, audit details, invitations, device storage)? [Gap, Spec §FR-016a]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for an invitation addressed to the owner-admin's own email or to an already-erased user's email (re-invite allowed) in all statuses? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 - Is behaviour defined when a user's Google account email changes after joining, or when Google returns an unverified email? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK033 - Are requirements defined for concurrent admin actions (e.g., erase while the user is mid-setup, or revoke while the invitee is accepting)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK034 - Is the recovery flow specified when the owner-admin is the only person who can act but their environment is paused by the hosting provider (free-tier pausing)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Plan R-15]
- [x] CHK035 - Does forced sign-out after 5 wrong PINs (FR-028) specify whether locally cached data on the device is wiped, as it is for erasure? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028]

## Non-Functional, Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK036 - Is the dependency on a third-party mailbox (Gmail + App Password) for invitation/reset delivery captured with failure behaviour (sending limit reached, credential revoked → what the owner sees)? [Dependency, Plan R-02]
- [x] CHK037 - Is the assumption that hosted free-tier security features (auth hooks, rate limits) remain available documented with an owner-review trigger if the provider changes plan terms? [Assumption, Plan R-01/R-05]
- [x] CHK038 - Are general application-log requirements (not just audit events) stated, so that errors never contain emails, tokens or financial details, per constitution Observability? [Gap, Constitution Workflow]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference

### Review record

- 2026-10-11: resolutions drafted at the owner's request.
- 2026-10-13: owner asked for a coverage check. First pass: 34 covered; CHK010 and CHK012 partially
  covered, CHK020 and CHK035 needed decisions. Owner decided: screenshots stay allowed with the
  recent-apps preview hidden (FR-027); after 5 wrong PINs, unsent entries are kept sealed and sent
  after the same user signs back in (FR-028). Fixes applied to FR-027, FR-028, FR-036c (session
  secret rotation), FR-036e (privacy notice on both joining paths), plus research, data model,
  http-api, quickstart and plan.
- 2026-10-13: second pass verified every item against the artifacts (all 38 covered; FR-037 and the
  data-model audit actions match, 20 actions). All items ticked on the owner's instruction.
